text: Ghost [Sansk. ghas , spirit]: Ger. (1) Gespenst ; Fr. (1) spectre , fantôme ; Ital. (1) ombra , anima . (1) An application, usually of the sort taken to be a disembodied spirit, but applied also to any sort of apparent manifestation from a spirit world. (2) An early word for SPIRIT (q.v.). ( J.M.B. )
